entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to attach to an EPC for packet services in EPS. Establishes context for the UE in MME and may establish default bearer for IP connectivity.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure. Contains attach type parameter.

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept attach request. May contain network feature indications.

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject attach request. Contains EMM cause codes.

entities.name: Attach type
entities.description: IE indicating type of attach requested, including EPS emergency attach.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state indicating UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH
entities.description: EMM substate where UE is attempting to attach.

entities.name: Attach attempt counter
entities.description: Counter that limits number of subsequently rejected attach attempts. Incremented and reset under specific conditions.

entities.name: T3245
entities.description: Timer started when UE receives ATTACH REJECT with certain EMM causes and stores PLMN in forbidden list.

entities.name: T3402
entities.description: Timer whose expiration resets attach attempt counter in EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH substate.

entities.name: T3346
entities.description: Timer whose start resets attach attempt counter in EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH substate.

entities.name: EMM cause #11 PLMN not allowed
entities.description: Condition when ATTACH REJECT contains EMM cause #11, causing UE to store PLMN in forbidden list and start T3245.

entities.name: EMM cause #14 EPS services not allowed in this PLMN
entities.description: Condition when ATTACH REJECT contains EMM cause #14, causing UE to store PLMN in forbidden list and start T3245.

entities.name: Default bearer established
entities.description: Property indicating establishment of default bearer between UE and PDN GW for always-on IP connectivity.

relations.description: Attach procedure begins with UE sending ATTACH REQUEST message.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains attach type information element.
Successful attach procedure establishes EMM-REGISTERED state.
Successful attach procedure with PDN connectivity request establishes default bearer.
ATTACH REJECT message may contain EMM cause #11 condition.
ATTACH REJECT message may contain EMM cause #14 condition.
Receiving ATTACH REJECT with EMM cause #11 starts timer T3245.
Receiving ATTACH REJECT with EMM cause #14 starts timer T3245.
Timer T3402 expiration resets attach attempt counter in EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH substate.
Timer T3346 start resets attach attempt counter in EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH substate.
Successful attach procedure resets attach attempt counter.
